text: My knee injury from last Friday has definitely put a temporary damper on my usual fitness routine, but I am managing to stay active by swimming and keeping things low-key until my physical therapy appointment comes through. Staying active is mega-important to me, so I refuse to let this setback keep me down for long. On the bright side, I am completely hooked on the book I am reading right now and can barely put it down. Should Evan ever ask for book recommendations for a weekend read, I will certainly suggest checking out novels by author Clara Vance. Looking ahead, I am already dreaming about my next outdoor adventures. Last month's road trip to Banff and the Rocky Mountains was so refreshing and brought back the best memories of cruising in my trusty car, especially since the skiing conditions and stunning mountain views were absolutely unbeatable. I am definitely planning to head back there next year for more skiing and snowboarding. Closer to home, I have been talking with Sam about organizing a future road trip and going on a hike together to explore some local trails and enjoy the tranquil scenery. Nature always chills me out and provides the best kind of escape from daily stress, and I cannot wait to get back on the trails once my knee is fully healed.
